problem.statement: Epilogue Fusion -- Overlapping MMA with Epilogue via Double-Buffering

payload.technique: Overlapping MMA with Epilogue via Double-Buffering
payload.what: The key to epilogue fusion on Blackwell is TMEM double-buffering. The 512-column TMEM space is split into two halves (columns 0-255 and 256-511). While the MMA warp accumulates into one half, the epilogue warps drain the other:
payload.when: The key to epilogue fusion on Blackwell is TMEM double-buffering.
